decision: The redesigned vise is not release-ready. Native OCCT and MCP library suites plus focused construction/drawing edits pass; final full recipe acceptance, changed jaw/keeper slicing and rebuilt desktop verification remain pending. No physical qualification has been performed.

superseded_previous_record.reason: Historical 60 mm / 48 mm-travel / five-printed-part replay evidence predates the mechanical redesign. It does not qualify the current six-part design.

source_revision_note: Frozen recipe source after gusset inset, keeper roof and through-access corrections; exact file hashes identify the candidate independently of later validation-only commits.

keeper.note: Matching printed shoulders receive opening load after seating; the M5 pin retains vertical installation. Rigid nominal clearances are not a physical load-sharing or backlash measurement.

design.hardware: M5/M6 envelopes; four optional outboard mounting bolts included

focused_native_construction.scope: Native construction prefix with the revised six printed bodies and a focused jaw drawing; two read calls and two final assertions. A separate cold-restored edit probe changes and restores jaw width and guide-mouth width and verifies native exported dimension text and retained topology. This is not the full acceptance suite.
assertions: Exactly six constructed bodies are present.

slicer_validation.scope_note: Isolated settings/data/output; authored orientations retained. No printer or existing GUI document operated. These process settings are toolpath probes, not a structural print recommendation.

prior_revision_finding.region: Jaw keeper-pocket rear wall at print Z32.4 mm
prior_revision_finding.correction: Central rear opening and 45-degree side shoulders; mating keeper ears with axial seating slot. The new geometry still requires actual slicing.

slicer_validation.bed_check_required: First layer must be nonempty and all model/brim extrusion envelopes must fit the selected extruder printable polygon and exclusion areas; bounding-box dimensions alone are insufficient.

full_native_acceptance.artifact_option: Set NBCAD_RECIPE_ARTIFACT_DIR to retain native projects, meshes and drawings.

rebuilt_desktop_validation.required: Final source build, attached native replay, model/assembly comparison, saved project and native print/drawing outputs.

remaining: Print the thread and guide coupon with the intended material and process.
Verify supplier hardware dimensions and actual assembly/maintenance access.
Measure total reversal travel, turning effort, guide rocking, off-centre jaw motion and retention.
Measure clamp force, sustained-load deformation/creep and repeated-use wear.
